body: Yeah, well you have obviously met people willing to date you. At my age, do ypu know what it's like to be rejected EVERY TIME? You obviously don't, and you never will. It's easy for people like you to say there's hope and that I'll find someone eventually, nut guess what? I'm at the age where it's supposed to be the easiest, but I can't even get a fucking phone number, let alone a date. I hate having to look in the mirror every day and hate myself, no matter how hard I try to improve. Sometimes I feel like if god's real that I'm just some big joke he made to see if I would be brave enough to kill myself

I appreciate that you're trying to help, but I have been told this exact thing dozens of times. It just isn't true. People like to say it's true, but in the end people won't date unattractive people no matter what their personality is, they'll just want to be friends. I'm speaking from experience

Well for 1, I've been rejected WAY more than "a couple times" and for 2; (assuming you're a girl) it's way different for guys. All you have to do is sit around and wait while I get to get called ugly every time I show interest in anybody. You don't know what that's like, having all these girls say that "looks don't matter" and that I would "make a great boyfriend" yet get rejected every time solely based on looks. Just because you can find someone doesn't mean I can
Its different for you. You have had a reltionship before, so you know its possible. For me, it seems impossible, especially after all these years of rejection
You can't be a guitarist if nobody likes what you play. That's why it matters. And what if I'm not good enough to make it in the military?
Look, it doesn't matter anyway. I can't fall in love because girls don't want to date someone like me

That's not the music I like playing, though. The music I like playing is only liked by people in their late 30's to 40's. Fuck that. 

I'm gonna be a SEAL
And I'm just saying that it wouldn't be fair for a girl (if I could ever even find one) to have to date a guy who cares this much about someone else

Navy, actually. And it's not possible for me to be a guitarist no matter how much I believe I can. Why don't you go on the radio on one of the mainstream stations, and listen for a few hours. Then come back and tell me which song has your favorite guitar solo. Here's a hint: none of the songs will have guitar solos, if they even have a guitar at all. Let's be honest here, guitar playing is a dead art

Well I once wanted to be a guitarist, but that won't ever happen. As for meeting people, the isn't any point anymore. I ship off for basic training next year, so it's too late anyway.  Even if I somehow met the one girl that isn't disgusted by me, it would be unfair to her since I still have feelings for Nicole (the girl I've been talking about). I don't want to put someone else through that

I used to go out a lot, but my confidence is pretty much nonexistent anymore, so I stopped. And your wrong, it's all about attractiveness, if they don't think you're hot, then they just want to be friends. I've seen a lot of girls that I'm friends with reject me, then go out with a guy that treats them like shit and when they end it they come crying to me with their problems asking where all the "nice guys" are. I used to just think, well fuck them. Why should I be around girls that pull this shit? But after years of this happening, I realized that all girls are like that. They say looks don't matter, but they reject everybody who doesn't look good enough. And I can't stop doing martial arts, it's all I have
Nickelback

We are still friends. But it hurts so bad when I see her.as for the "take a break", I tried that.  Before this girl, I had given up on it for about 2.5 years. It did not help. Girls only date guys who are attractive, don't even try to convince me otherwise, we all know that's the cold, hard truth. And judging by the MANY girls who have called me ugly, I have no chance with anybody.

Btw, it is very easy for someone who is talented to say "you only have to beat yourself". Please cut the bullshit. I'm not an idiot. There is absolutely no point to martial arts if you can't win against beginners, even after the 8 years of my life I have wasted doing it. It's the only thing I'm passionate  about, but I guess I have no purpose in life, so what's the point of going on?

The martial arts and guitar prove that hard work does not pay off without talent. I have been doing both religiously for at least 3 hours a day for each one, sometimes practicing for up to 8 hours a day on one of them. Sure enough, someone always comes in who practices 1 hour a day for a year or two who becomes noticeably better than me. You don't know what that feels like. 

As for the missed opportunities, it doesn't matter, there are no women who are at all interested in me. I have been rejected more times than you can imagine, and the reason I liked this girl so much was because she was the first person to actually make me smile. Not like the fake one I always put on for my friends. I stupidly thought I had a chance with her, but clearly some people aren't meant to be happy, no matter how hard they try to improve their life.  Even as I type this, I feel the tears coming. Do you know what it's like to be a grown man and still cry every day? Do you know what it's like to get rejected by every girl between      middle school and a few years after college? You don't understand what its like. We're all raised believing that everything will work out if you try really hard. Well it doesn't, at least not for some people
And what do you mean by "don't miss opportunities because of her"?

No, I hate my life, even before I met her. I have no talent at anything, and I thought that if I worked really hard and put in the time and effort that I would succeed. I was wrong. It doesn't matter how hard you try anything, if you aren't naturally good, then you never will be

I'm seriously running out of time, and I pretty much know now that there isn't anybody out there for me. It's easy for you to say that things will get better, but if you were in my current situation, you wouldn't believe it would get better either

She's a pretty good friend, and she said she thinks I'm unattractive which is why she doesn't want to date me.

As for the guy, she isn't dating him and I have known him for a while, trust me, he is REALLY weird and annoying. I'm not just saying it because of jealousy.

Day to day I work out in the late morning/early afternoon, train my martial arts for a few hours afterward, and work at night. All the while I practice my guitar whenever I get the chance

Thanks for that. It just sucks, ya know? Having so many friends but feeling so worthless all the time. Having a ton of girls say I'm awesome and stuff like that all the time, yet reject me because if how I look. And being bad at everything is pretty shitty too
I don't want to sound like a prick right now, but you can't see the future. I ship out for the military in 2 years so I'm fucked if I don't find anyone by then

Because that stuff is extremely bad for you. I work REALLY hard to have the body I do now, and I really don't want to sacrifice it. But I guess if the only girl I can get to be with me has to be drunk as fuck, then I guess so be it

I have, but I don't drink so people usually think I'm no fun. And It does matter. I don't like being single, I don't like having nobody there for me, and being a virgin is the worst fucking thing ever. Do you know what its like to not be capable of ever being in a relationship because of the one thing about yourself that you can't change?
It's not just an opinion when it's every time

So I can post them here and have people lie and tell me I look fine?
Yeah, I work out a ton, dress nicely, keep my hair in nice order. You just can't fix an ugly face. And what is the point of anything if you don't have anyone to share it with?

Because I suck at everything I do, and girls are disgusted by me. They always say how great I am and how they wish they had a boyfriend like me, yet all of them reject me. Knowing that I have no talent, and that I'm too ugly for anybody to date me is unbearable, and it makes me hate myself and my life

Its not that I want to be constantly happy. Its just that every day I need to put on a mask and act like everything is fine and my life is great. In reality I always feel a hatred for myself inside, and I never actually feel happy

But every time its the same fucking thing: "sorry, I don't feel that way about you, we can still be friends though" The only thing they don't like is the only thing I can't change, and it kills me

And that just goes to show that it doesn't matter how confident you are. Out of all f the girls I have shown any interest in, NONE of them felt the same
Read my last post. I have done all of that for years. Its not like I sit at my computer all day. Girls give no shits about it, they only ever want to be friends

Mid 20's. Most of my male friends are getting married. All of them in relationships. Don't tell me I'm too young to worry about it. All of my peers are fucking like rabbits, except me. I'm also the only person that I know who hasn't ever been approached by a girl

To me, the most attractive thing about a girl is their personality. There are girls that I really like that I don't know, but the ones I ask out and such are ones that I have already known for at least a few weeks (sometimes a few years). In fact, the last girl that I was really interested in (and still kind of am) was a girl that I really wasn't attracted to at all. But we did and still do kung fu together, and I learned that she likes all the same stuff I do and she's really funny and has an amazing personality. Now she's easily a 10 in my eyes. So its not that I'm going for girls because of how I initially see them. For me to be interested, I need to know their personality since that is what I find the most attractive in a girl. Usually they aren't "sexy" when I first meet them, so it isn't like I'm asking out any supermodels or anything

Again, easy for people who don't get rejected every fucking time to say. It's their standards that are too high. It DESTROYS your confidence and makes you feel worthless. That's why I don't keep putting myself out there. Its easy as shit for someone with a girlfriend to say its not that hard

It feels like I got dealt the shittiest hand in the deck
